description: This file defines utility functions and types for handling tool call locations, resource escaping, prompt extraction, and tool kind inference within an agent protocol SDK context.

methods.name: escapeInlineControlChars
methods.description: Escapes inline control characters in a string to their safe representations.

methods.name: escapeResourceTitle
methods.description: Escapes resource titles, escaping control characters and special symbols.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a plain object (record).

methods.name: normalizeToolLocationPath
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a file path string for tool location purposes.

methods.name: normalizeToolLocationLine
methods.description: Normalizes a line number value to a positive integer.

methods.name: extractToolLocationLine
methods.description: Extracts line number from a record based on known keys.

methods.name: addToolLocation
methods.description: Adds a tool location to a map, avoiding duplicates and handling line info.

methods.name: collectLocationsFromTextMarkers
methods.description: Extracts file paths from text markers using regex.

methods.name: collectToolLocations
methods.description: Recursively collects tool locations from nested data structures.

methods.name: extractTextFromPrompt
methods.description: Concatenates text content from prompt blocks, respecting max size.

methods.name: extractAttachmentsFromPrompt
methods.description: Extracts image attachments from prompt blocks.

methods.name: formatToolTitle
methods.description: Formats a tool title with arguments, escaping control characters.

methods.name: inferToolKind
methods.description: Infers the kind of tool based on its name string.

methods.name: extractToolCallContent
methods.description: Extracts structured content from a tool call value.

methods.name: extractToolCallLocations
methods.description: Collects and returns all tool call locations from given values.
